appDescription.message: Reduce accidental Enter-key sends in Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Google Flow, Google Chat on the web, and Chat inside Gmail.

sidePanelNotice.message: Supports Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Google Flow, Google Chat on the web, and Google Chat inside Gmail. The browser's built-in Gemini side panel and Google Meet chat are not supported.

flowShortcutNotice.message: Command-key sending shortcuts are currently not supported in Google Flow.
